notes: User desktop is i3wm on Pop!_OS with Catppuccin Mocha theme
Dotfiles managed at ~/.local/share/dotfiles with remote DesktopConfigs

entries.content: Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS (x86_64, systemd), i3wm tiling window manager, Polybar, Dunst, Rofi, Alacritty, Picom. Catppuccin Mocha theme with dynamic accent color (#2977af) and background (#111417). Strict 0px border-radius across all windows and widgets.
Dotfiles repository located at ~/.local/share/dotfiles (remote GitHub DesktopConfigs, branch main). Managed via custom wrapper `dotfiles` (push, pull, status, diff).

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12GB VRAM), Intel Core i5-12400F, 16GB RAM. Ollama server running locally on http://127.0.0.1:11434 with models: qwen2.5-coder:14b-instruct-q4_K_M, llama3.1:8b-instruct-q5_K_M, and moondream vision.
User nickname is Sammy. Strict preference for 0px square corners (no rounded borders) and Nerd Font monochrome glyphs instead of colorful emojis. No cute mascot strings or ASCII faces.
Zen Browser configured with customized duckduckgo search engine using bangs, customized extensions, and synchronized with dotfiles.
